text: Soren Lindqvist takes the exact QAOA circuit that worked beautifully on Qiskit Aer's ideal simulator and submits it, unchanged, to ibm_brisbane -- a real 127-qubit IBM quantum processor.
Same QUBO, same depth-p=2 ansatz, same COBYLA-optimized angles -- transpiled for ibm_brisbane's real coupling map and submitted through Qiskit Runtime's SamplerV2 primitive.
Real hardware means real limits: a shared job queue, and a limited monthly allotment of QPU time under IBM Quantum's free Open Plan -- nothing like a simulator's unlimited, instant shots.
Three jobs go in, 4,000 shots each, mirroring the three repeated runs already validated on the simulator -- so the comparison will be fair, run for run.
All three jobs are accepted and queued. Nothing has come back yet.
